description_expanded: Overview5.0(3 reviews)INLET BEACH – Coral Cay Luxury Home | Private Heated Pool & Hot Tub | Sleeps 21 DESCRIPTION Welcome to Coral Cay, a stunning coastal retreat offering luxury and comfort in one breathtaking package. With 8 beautifully appointed bedrooms, each with its own private bath, plus two additional hall baths, this exquisite home accommodates up to 21 guests. Relax in the expansive outdoor space with a private heated pool and hot tub, ideal for year-round enjoyment. The spacious decks, creating the perfect atmosphere for unwinding after a day at the beach. Every detail in Coral Cay has been designed with sophistication in mind, from the elegant finishes to the custom features that add a touch of refinement to each room. And with the beach just a short walk away, you’ll have the ultimate coastal experience right at your doorstep. OUTDOOR LIVING & BEACH ACCESS Soak up the sun by the private heated pool or enjoy a soothing soak in the hot tub. The multiple decks is perfect for relaxing and taking in the scenery. Beach access is steps away via the Lupine Beach Neighborhood Beach Walkover (note: includes stairs and is not handicap accessible). HOME FEATURES 8 bedrooms | 8 full bathrooms & 2 half-bath | Sleeps 21 Private heated pool and hot tub Expansive decks Large living areas designed for comfort Gourmet kitchen with high-end finishes Smart TVs and WiFi Elevator for easy access across all levels Pet friendly (additional pet fee applies) DINING & ENTERTAINMENT Close to 30A dining Nearby boutique shopping, and restaurants Quiet Inlet Beach location for ultimate privacy WHY STAY HERE? Perfect for large families or group vacations Luxurious and spacious design Ideal location near the beach with access to local attractions SLEEPING ACCOMMODATIONS 6 King bedrooms Bedroom with 1 King and 1 Queen bunk bed Bedroom with one Queen and three twin beds Coral Cay offers more than just a place to stay. It’s an experience that combines luxury, comfort, and unforgettable memories in a stunning coastal setting on 30A. Please Note: The neighborhood is growing, and with that comes a bit of construction nearby, including in front of the house. While it’s entirely out of our control, we always want to be upfront so there are no surprises. We appreciate your understanding as this beautiful area continues to develop.Show less
